name: MacDill AFB
description: Home of the 6th Air Refueling Wing and USCENTCOM / USSOCOM. MacDill's KC-135 and KC-46 tankers support global operations.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant license or passport required for base access. Allow extra time at gates during peak hours (0700-0900).

gates.name: Main Gate (S Dale Mabry Hwy)
gates.notes: Primary access from S Dale Mabry Hwy. Visitor Control Center located at main gate.
gates.address: 6801 S Dale Mabry Hwy, MacDill AFB, FL 33621

gates.name: Bayshore Gate (Bayshore Blvd)
gates.notes: Access from Bayshore Boulevard. DoD ID holders only — no visitor processing.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (S Dale Mabry)
gates.notes: New visitors with sponsor must stop here for day passes. REAL ID required.
gates.address: 6801 S Dale Mabry Hwy (at Main Gate), MacDill AFB, FL 33621

resources.name: Diner’s Reef Dining Facility (DFAC)
resources.description: Primary DFAC supporting 6 ARW, CENTCOM, SOCOM and 33 mission partners. 350-seat dining room with weekend brunch options (omelets, carving station, avocado toast). Flight/ground meals with 2-hour notice.
resources.hours: Breakfast Mon-Fri 0600-0900 / Weekends & Holidays 0630-0830; Lunch Daily 1100-1330; Dinner Daily 1630-1830
resources.address: 8118 Hillsborough Loop Dr, Bldg 263, MacDill AFB, FL 33621

resources.name: Bayshore Club (All-Ranks Club)
resources.description: All-ranks club dining with waterfront views of Tampa Bay. Happy hours, trivia nights, and private event space.

resources.name: Subway (BX Food Court)
resources.description: Subway sandwich shop in the MacDill Exchange food court.
resources.address: 2917 Crenshaw Lake Rd (BX), MacDill AFB, FL 33621

resources.name: Charley's Grilled Subs (BX Food Court)

resources.name: Popeyes (BX Food Court)

resources.name: MacDill Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service BX: clothing, electronics, optical, barbershop, food court, and Military Star card.
resources.address: 2917 Crenshaw Lake Rd, MacDill AFB, FL 33621

resources.name: MacDill Commissary
resources.description: Full-service commissary grocery with deli, bakery, and CLICK2GO curbside.
resources.address: 2908 N Boundary Blvd, MacDill AFB, FL 33621-5009

resources.name: MacDill Medical Clinic (6th MDG)
resources.description: Outpatient military treatment facility: primary care, specialty clinics, pharmacy, dental, and behavioral health.
resources.hours: Primary care: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; Urgent care: Mon-Fri 0730-1600; pharmacy: Mon-Fri 0730-1700

resources.name: MacDill Outpatient Pharmacy
resources.description: TRICARE outpatient pharmacy. Express Scripts mail order available.

resources.name: 6th Dental Squadron
resources.description: Active-duty dental clinic. Appointment required.

resources.name: Tanker Way Fitness Center (Main Gym)
resources.description: Main fitness center: weight room, cardio, racquetball, basketball, and group exercise. 24/7 CAC access after registration.

resources.name: HQ CENTCOM / SOCOM Fitness Center
resources.description: Fitness center serving CENTCOM and SOCOM HQ personnel.

resources.name: Vandenberg Pool (Outdoor Aquatics)
resources.description: Outdoor seasonal swimming pool with lap lanes and swim lessons.

resources.name: MacDill FCU / Grow Financial (On-Base Branch)
resources.description: Grow Financial Federal Credit Union (formerly MacDill FCU) — full-service branch with checking, savings, auto loans, and VA home loans. ATM on-site.

resources.name: USAA ATM (Near BX)
resources.description: USAA surcharge-free ATM in the Exchange area.

resources.name: 6 ARW Comptroller Squadron (Finance)
resources.description: Military pay, travel vouchers, and finance customer service.

resources.name: 6th Force Support Squadron (MPF)
resources.description: ID cards, DEERS, assignments, promotions, separations, and retirements.

resources.name: 6th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: All MWR programs, family support, dining, fitness, and recreation.
resources.hours: Facility hours listed on FSS website

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation, deployment support, financial readiness, and family programs.

resources.name: 6 ABG Housing Management Office
resources.description: Government and privatized (Corvias) family housing assignments and referrals.

resources.name: Bay Palms Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Waterfront-adjacent TDY and PCS temporary lodging. Highly popular — book early via AF Reservations.
resources.hours: Lodging desk open 24 hours daily; check-in 1400, check-out 1100

resources.name: Dormitory Management Office
resources.description: Unaccompanied housing management for eligible E-1 to E-3 permanent-party personnel.

resources.name: MacDill Golf Course (Bayshore Golf Course)
resources.description: 18-hole golf course with waterfront views of Tampa Bay, pro shop, and restaurant.
resources.hours: Daily sunrise to sunset; pro shop 0700-1800

resources.name: MacDill Marina & Waterfront Recreation
resources.description: Marina with boat slips, kayak/paddleboard rentals, fishing pier, and watercraft rentals on Tampa Bay.

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation (ODR)
resources.description: Equipment rental, camping gear, tickets, and outdoor adventure programs.

resources.name: MacDill Bowling Center
resources.description: Bowling center with food, arcade, and league play.

resources.name: MacDill Beach
resources.description: On-base beach access on Tampa Bay with picnic areas, volleyball, and grills.

resources.name: MacDill Visitor Control Center
resources.description: Visitor passes and base access. Sponsor required for visitors. REAL ID required.

resources.name: 6th Security Forces Squadron
resources.description: Base defense and law enforcement.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage/birth certificates, and travel voucher receipts.

sections.title: In-Processing
sections.body: Check in with your gaining unit and complete MPF in-processing within required timelines. CENTCOM and SOCOM personnel have separate reporting procedures.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Housing before arrival. Privatized housing by Corvias available for families. Temporary lodging: Bay Palms Inn 813-828-4259. Dorm management: 813-828-4259.

sections.title: Tampa Bay Area
sections.body: MacDill is on a peninsula in Tampa Bay — excellent weather, beaches, and sports teams. Traffic on S Dale Mabry can be heavy during rush hour (0700-0900 and 1600-1800).
